current_conclusion: Current official OpenAI evidence continues to support Plugin-mediated custom or local MCP tool use on ChatGPT Work on the web. C8 therefore requires separate fresh visible Work, entitlement, quota, and operator authorization evidence before exposing the single reviewed probe.
